description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.2.9
更新内容
- 新增图片拼接：从截图历史、贴图或选中的图片创建拼图，在编辑器中调整布局，然后复制或保存结果。
- 复用选区更方便：浏览之前的选区，快速选回需要的区域；可在设置中配置上一选区、下一选区快捷键。
- 键盘截图更顺手：默认按 Enter 复制截图；同时按住两个方向的移动快捷键可斜向移动光标。
- 日常修复：改善 macOS 截图窗口关闭、贴图原图预览对齐、文字边缘显示和全屏快捷键行为；导出时提示文件名冲突。
What's new
- Image stitching: create a collage from screenshot history, pinned images, or selected image files. Adjust its layout, then copy or save the result.
- Reuse selection areas: browse previous areas and return to the one you need. Configure previous/next area shortcuts in Settings.
- Easier keyboard capture: Enter copies a screenshot by default. Hold movement shortcuts for two directions together to move the cursor diagonally.
- Everyday fixes: improved macOS screenshot closing, alignment of original-image previews, text edge rendering, and fullscreen shortcut handling. Export warns about filename conflicts.
下载选择 / Choose your download
完整版提供全部功能；Mini 保留截图、标注、贴图、拼图、录屏和手动 OCR，精简高级识别、翻译和 API 配置。Windows Mini 首次识别时下载 OCR 组件和模型。/ Full provides all features. Mini keeps capture, annotation, pinning, stitching, recording, and manual OCR, with advanced recognition, translation, and API configuration removed. Windows Mini downloads OCR components and a model on first use.

macOS 快速安装 / Install on macOS
需要 macOS 15 或更新版本。以当前桌面用户在终端执行：/ Requires macOS 15 or later. Run in Terminal as your desktop user:
Snow Shot
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.2.9_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh --edition full
Snow Shot Mini（仅 Apple Silicon / Apple Silicon only）
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.2.9_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh --edition mini
脚本自动选择架构、校验安装包并完成本地签名。首次安装按提示授予屏幕录制和辅助功能权限。GitHub 下载不畅时，可把链接中的 https://github.com 替换为 https://gitee.com。/ The script selects your architecture, verifies the package, and signs it locally. Grant Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions when prompted. If GitHub is unavailable, replace https://github.com with https://gitee.com in download links or commands.
